title: CI/CD Pipeline Compiler
description: Compiles CI/CD pipeline definitions (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). Enforces: at least one trigger, all jobs in valid stages, no cyclic dependencies, required quality gates present, no hardcoded secrets.

error_codes.CIP001: ci-cd-spec.json missing or invalid — required: platform, triggers[], stages[], jobs[]
error_codes.CIP002: No trigger defined — pipeline will never execute
error_codes.CIP003: Job references stage or dependency that does not exist
error_codes.CIP005: Hardcoded secret value found in pipeline definition
error_codes.CIP006: Required quality gate stage missing: must include build, test, or deploy stage
